l10nDeploymentClosed.description: Statement that the deployment window has closed.

l10nDeploymentOpen.description: Statement that the deployment window is open.

l10nDeploymentWindow.description: What is the original deployment window.

l10nYourTimezone.description: What is the deployment window in your local timezone.

l10nNoInformation.message: No deployment information for this domain.
l10nNoInformation.description: There is no information for this domain.

l10nNoInformationHint.message: Nothing on this page matches a configured site and deployment.
l10nNoInformationHint.description: Explains why the popup has nothing to show.

l10nNoDomainInformationSet.message: No site information has been set.

l10nOpenSettings.description: Popup link through to the options page.

l10nSpacing.description: Section for the notice spacing overrides.

l10nSpacingHint.message: Optional. The notice brings its own styling; these only adjust how it sits on this site.

l10nMarginHint.message: Space around the notice, such as 1.25rem 0.

l10nMaxWidth.description: Widest the notice will be drawn.

l10nMaxWidthHint.message: How wide it may get before it stops growing. It stays centred.
l10nMaxWidthHint.description: Hint for the max width field.

l10nOptionsSubtitle.message: Choose where the deployment notice appears, and when deploys are allowed.
l10nOptionsSubtitle.description: Subtitle under the options page title.

l10nEditMode.description: Switch that reveals the editing controls.

l10nFilterPlaceholder.message: Filter by name, key or URL

l10nNoMatches.description: Shown when the filter excludes everything.

l10nOpenNow.description: Count of deployment windows currently open.

l10nNotConfigured.description: Placeholder where no URL fragment is configured.

l10nNoWindowSet.description: Status for a deployment with no times.

l10nNoWindowSetHint.message: Without times this always reads as closed. Edit it to add a deployment window, or mark it notes only.

l10nNoDeploymentsYetHint.message: Add one for each project you want a notice on.

l10nNoSitesYetHint.message: A site says which pages the notice can appear on, and where it goes.

l10nNewDeployment.description: Title of the create deployment dialog.

l10nEditDeployment.description: Title of the edit deployment dialog.

l10nNewSite.description: Title of the create site dialog.

l10nEditSite.description: Title of the edit site dialog.

l10nDuplicate.description: Copy an entry into a new one.

l10nCopySuffix.description: Appended to the name of a duplicated entry.

l10nRemove.description: Remove a row from a repeating list.

l10nAdded.description: Confirmation that a new entry was stored.

l10nDeleted.description: Confirmation that an entry was removed.

l10nRestored.description: Confirmation that an undo was applied.

l10nSaveFailed.message: Could not save. Your changes were not stored.

l10nDeploymentFormHint.message: One project, and when it can be deployed.

l10nKey.description: The config key for an entry.

l10nKeyHint.message: A unique id used in the stored config. Filled in from the name.

l10nNameHint.message: Shown as the title of the notice and the popup.

l10nNotesHint.message: Markdown is supported. Shown behind "Show details" on the page.

l10nNotesOnlyHint.message: Show only the notes, with no deployment window or status. Use it for a freeze.

l10nCaseSensitiveHint.message: Match the URL exactly, including capitals. Off by default.
l10nCaseSensitiveHint.description: Hint for the case sensitive switch.

l10nTimeHint.message: 24 hour times. A window may close earlier than it opens to run past midnight.

l10nTimezoneHint.message: The timezone these times are written in. Everyone sees them converted to their own.

l10nUseMyTimezone.description: Fill the timezone field with the local timezone.

l10nUrlFragmentsHint.message: The part of the URL that identifies this project on each site. Leave a site blank to skip it.

l10nSiteFormHint.message: Where the notice can appear, and how it looks there.

l10nSiteKey.description: The config key for a site.

l10nSiteKeyHint.message: How deployments refer to this site, for example github.

l10nInsertHint.message: The notice is placed at the first of these that exists on the page.

l10nRequired.description: A required field was left blank.

l10nKeyFormat.message: Use letters, numbers, dashes or underscores.

l10nDuplicateKey.message: That key is already in use.

l10nReservedKey.message: That key is reserved. Pick another.
l10nReservedKey.description: Key clashes with a deployment field.

l10nInvalidTime.message: Use a 24 hour time, such as 09:00.

l10nInvalidLength.message: Use a CSS length, such as 1rem, 12px or 0.
l10nInvalidLength.description: Error for a spacing value that is not a CSS length.

l10nPatternRequired.message: Add at least one URL pattern.

l10nInsertRequired.message: Add at least one place to insert the notice.

l10nFragmentRequired.message: Add a URL fragment for at least one site, or this can never match a page.

l10nNotesRequired.message: A notes only entry needs some notes.

l10nJsonTitle.description: Title of the raw config panel.

l10nJsonHint.message: Everything above as raw JSON. Copy it between machines, or paste a whole config in.
l10nJsonHint.description: Description of the raw config panel.

l10nCopy.description: Copy the config to the clipboard.

l10nDownload.description: Download the config as a file.

l10nImportFile.description: Load a config from a file.

l10nRevert.description: Discard edits in the JSON editor.

l10nUnsaved.description: The JSON editor has unsaved edits.

l10nInvalidJson.description: Prefix for a JSON parse error.

l10nDeploymentsSubtitle.message: One per project. Each card shows whether it can be deployed right now.

l10nSitesSubtitle.message: Where a notice can appear, and how it looks once it is there.

l10nHowToUseSubtitle.message: A guide to everything on this page, and to the config behind it.

l10nWindowStartHint.description: Hint for the window start time.

l10nWindowEndHint.message: Set this earlier than the opening time to run past midnight.
l10nWindowEndHint.description: Hint for the window end time.

l10nUrlFragmentFieldHint.message: Matched anywhere in the URL, so a repository path or a ticket prefix both work.
l10nUrlFragmentFieldHint.description: Hint for the url fragment fields.

l10nPatternRowHint.message: A * scheme covers both http and https; a leading *. covers every subdomain.
l10nPatternRowHint.description: Hint for the url pattern rows.

l10nPositionHint.message: Whether the notice goes above or below that element.

l10nElementHint.message: A class name from the page, without the leading dot. A CSS selector works too, such as #repository-container-header.

l10nAnyHost.description: Shown when a site pattern names no particular host.
